messages:
Raj (Marketing): Heads-up — we need a small asset pack for next week's webinar and accompanying launch posts. Goal: 1 hero benchmark tile, 3 social microtiles, a one-slide ‘benchmark snapshot’ diagram, and 2 CTA variants for the sign-up funnel. Deadline: first drafts in 48h, final by EOD Friday.
Mia (Design): Got it. Quick Qs: what’s the primary metric to show on the hero? target audience (devs vs PMs)? any localization needed? file sizes?
Raj (Marketing): Primary metric = median latency reduction vs baseline (p50 in ms) + cost per 1k tokens. Audience = primarily engineering + platform leads. Localization: en-US + en-GB (copy tweaks only). Sizes: hero 1200x628, microtiles 800x800, slide 1200x900.
Tessa (Demand Gen): CTA variants — we need one that routes to gated webinar + one that goes to a case study signup (different forms). Add UTM params: utm_source=bench-launch utm_campaign=wm24. Also prefer the shorter CTA copy for social.
Luca (Product): Adding the 3 datapoints you can show: p50 latency down 38%, tokens/sec up 2.4x, cost/unit down 31%. I can drop a CSV of the time series if you want sparklines.
Mia (Design): CSV for sparklines would be perfect — please upload to the shared folder. Also want brand-safe color palette from Alex before I start (need accessible contrast).
Alex (Brand): Use primary accent #0066FF for hero highlights, neutral palette for backgrounds. Avoid gradients on benchmark numbers. For accessibility, numbers should pass AA at 18px. Logos: use stacked mark on white only — legal already flagged external co-branding; if partners are shown confirm approvals.
Raj (Marketing): Noted re: logos. No external co-branding on this set. Tessa — form routing: when someone clicks CTA A -> /webinar?form=webinar-reg; CTA B -> /case-study?form=cs-reg. Use utm params above.
DesignBot: Figma file created: https://figma.com/file/abc123/mini-benchpack (draft page + components). Auto-synced to /design/benchmark/mini-benchpack.
Mia (Design): Thanks — I'll start with a compact grid so assets can be repurposed. Quick sketch of deliverables and export settings:
```
- hero: 1200x628 @2x export PNG + SVG for web
- microtile: 800x800 @2x PNG
- slide: 1200x900 PDF export + PNG
- sparkline: SVG + 2x PNG
- source: Figma components + text tokens
```
Mia (Design): Checklist for handoff:
- copy variants (short & long) from Raj
- CSV for sparklines from Luca
- brand palette + logo files from Alex
- UTM/form routing from Tessa
Mia (Design): I'll post first draft links in this thread when done (~48h).
Raj (Marketing): Copy variants: (short) "See serving wins in action — join our webinar"; (long) "See how serving-level optimizations cut latency and cost — live demo + benchmarks". Use short for microtiles.
Tessa (Demand Gen): For routing please add hidden field form.source=bench-launch and set thank-you redirect to /thanks?utm_source=bench-launch.
Luca (Product): CSV uploaded to the shared folder: /data/bench-sparklines/mini-launch.csv. Contains p50, p95, and cost series.
Alex (Brand): Uploaded logo assets to the Figma file and added color tokens. Small note: use color token --brand-accent-1 rather than hex to keep tokenized exports.
Mia (Design): Great — grabbing everything now. Will prioritize hero + one microtile first so we can run AB copy tests.
Raj (Marketing): Perfect. Please tag me and Tessa on the first draft. If anything blocks brand/legal, ping Alex ASAP. :thumbsup:
Mia (Design): Will do. Target: drafts posted by 48 hours from now (1900000001 + 172800).
Raj (Marketing): Thanks team — appreciate the quick turnaround.
DesignBot: Reminder scheduled: review checkpoint in 36 hours.
